items.title: 11.1 Dil (heart) ki banawat aur kaam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 11.1, printed pages 231-238.

blocks.text: Insanon mein jism ke mukhtalif hisson tak maddon ki naqal (transport) ke do nizam hain: khoon ka daurani nizam (blood circulatory system) aur lymphatic system. Insan ka band (closed) khoon ka daurani nizam khoon, dil (heart) aur khoon ki naliyon (arteries, capillaries aur veins) par mushtamil hai.

blocks.title: Yaad-dehani: khoon
blocks.text: Khoon woh zariya hai jis mein hal shuda nutrients, gaisein, hormones aur fuzla poore jism mein le jaye jate hain. Yeh plasma aur cells ya cell jaisi ajsam (white blood cells, red blood cells, platelets) par mushtamil hai. Sehatmand shakhs mein plasma hajm ke lihaz se khoon ka qareeb 55% aur cells qareeb 45% hain.

Insani dil ek sakht mehnat karne wala pump hai jo khoon ko jism mein chalata hai. Yeh seene ke khale ke darmiyan, phephron ke beech, waqe hai; is ki pichli satah reerh ki haddi (vertebral column) ke qareeb aur agli satah sternum aur pasliyon ke cartilages ke peeche hai.
Pericardium

Dil ek thaili, pericardium, mein band hai jo use gird ke aza se alag karti hai. Is ki bairooni tah, fibrous pericardium, mazboot connective tissue ki bani hai; yeh dil ko bairooni dabao aur jhatkon se bachati aur us ke had se zyada phailne ko rokti hai. Is ki andarooni tah, serous pericardium, khud do tahon ki thaili hai: fibrous pericardium ke neeche bairooni parietal pericardium, aur dil se kas kar juri andarooni visceral pericardium (jise epicardium bhi kehte hain). In ke darmiyan ki jagah, pericardial cavity, mein 50 mL tak pericardial fluid hai, jo dil ko chikna rakhta aur infections se bachata hai.
Dil ki deewar

Dil ki deewar ki teen tahein hain. Pericardium ki andarooni tah, epicardium, deewar ki bairooni tah banati hai. Is ke neeche sab se moti tah, myocardium, hai jo cardiac muscle ki bani hai. Myocardium ke neeche endocardium hai, epithelial cells ki ek tah jo dil ke khanon (chambers) ki andarooni tah banati hai.

blocks.title: Dil baen taraf kyun mehsoos hota hai
blocks.text: Dil aam taur par baen taraf is liye mehsoos hota hai ke dil ka baen hissa zyada mazboot aur bara hai, kyunke yeh jism ke tamam hisson tak pump karta hai. Chunke dil phephron ke beech hai, baen phephra daen se chhota hai aur is ke kinare mein dil ke liye ek cardiac notch hai.
Dil ke khane (chambers) aur valves

Dil ke chaar khane hain: do oopri patli-deewar atria aur do nichle moti-deewar ventricles. Atria jism se khoon lete aur ventricles ko dete hain, jo use jism mein taqseem karte hain. Atria aur ventricles atrioventricular septum se alag hain; dono atria interatrial septum se; aur dono ventricles interventricular septum se, jo interatrial septum se kahin mota hai. Baen ventricle ki deewar daen ventricle se qareeb teen guna moti hai, kyunke use khoon poore jism mein dhakelna hota hai.

items: Atrioventricular valves, atrioventricular septum mein ventricles ke daakhle par: teen parton (cusps) ka tricuspid valve daen atrium aur daen ventricle ke darmiyan, aur do parton ka bicuspid ya mitral valve baen atrium aur baen ventricle ke darmiyan. Jab ventricles sukarte hain to yeh valves band ho kar atria mein wapsi rokte hain.

Semilunar valves (aadhe chand jaisi shakal), ventricles ke nikas par: pulmonary artery ki bunyad par pulmonary valve aur aorta ki bunyad par aortic valve. Jab ventricles dheele hote hain to yeh valves band ho kar pulmonary artery aur aorta se ventricles mein wapsi rokte hain.

blocks.text: Dil mein khoon ka daura

Dil ek double pump ka kaam karta hai, pulmonary circulation (phephron ko khoon ki faraahmi) aur systemic circulation (phephron ke siwa tamam aza ko khoon ki faraahmi) karta hai. Deoxygenated khoon (daen taraf) aur oxygenated khoon (baen taraf) ki mukammal alahidgi qaim rehti hai. Daen atrium jism se deoxygenated khoon superior aur inferior venae cavae se leta hai aur tricuspid valve se daen ventricle ko deta hai; jab daen ventricle sukarta hai to khoon semilunar pulmonary valve se pulmonary trunk mein jata hai, jo baen aur daen pulmonary arteries mein bat kar phephron tak jati hai. Phephron se oxygenated khoon pulmonary veins baen atrium tak lati hain aur yeh bicuspid valve se baen ventricle ko jata hai; jab baen ventricle sukarta hai to khoon aortic valve se aorta mein jata hai, jo use phephron ke siwa jism ke tamam hisson tak le jati hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar box khane: baen neele daen atrium aur daen ventricle, daen surkh baen atrium aur baen ventricle, darmiyan narangi septa. Neele teer venae cavae se daen atrium, tricuspid valve aur daen ventricle se ho kar oopar pulmonary trunk tak jate hain; surkh teer pulmonary veins se baen atrium, bicuspid valve aur baen ventricle se oopar aorta tak. Kaale tikon valves dikhate hain. Neeche notes pericardium aur deewar ki teen tahein bayan karte hain.
blocks.caption: Dil ke khane, valves aur khoon ka rasta, pericardium aur deewar ki tahon ke saath (Figures 11.1 aur 11.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Superior aur inferior venae cavae se deoxygenated khoon patli-deewar daen atrium ko bharta hai, teen parton wale tricuspid valve se daen ventricle mein jata hai, aur pulmonary valve se pulmonary trunk aur phephron mein pump hota hai. Oxygenated khoon pulmonary veins se baen atrium ko wapas aata hai, do parton wale bicuspid (mitral) valve se baen ventricle mein jata hai, jis ki deewar qareeb teen guna moti hai, aur aortic valve se aorta mein pump hota hai. Interatrial aur mota interventricular septa dono taraf ko alag rakhte hain. Dil ke gird fibrous pericardium aur 50 mL tak mayah wali do-tah serous pericardium hai; deewar epicardium, moti myocardium aur endocardium hai.

blocks.text: Cardiac cycle: dil ki dharkan

Dil musalsal cycles mein kaam karta hai. Is ke khane dheele ho kar bari veins se khoon se ghair-faal taur par bharte hain, phir sukar kar khoon ko jism mein dhakelte hain; yeh baari baari dheela hona aur sukarna ek cardiac cycle, ya ek dharkan (heartbeat), hai. Jab atria dheele aur bhar rahe hon to ventricles bhi dheele hote hain: yeh dheela daur diastole hai, jis mein dono atria khoon se bharte hain. Jaise atria mein khoon jama hota hai un ka dabao barhta hai aur dono sukarte hain, atrial systole mein, jo khoon ko tricuspid aur bicuspid valves se dono dheele ventricles mein bhejti hai. Jab ventricles bhar jayen to dono sukarte hain, ventricular systole mein, jo khoon ko pulmonary arteries aur aorta mein pump karti hai; ventricular systole ke dauran tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band aur pulmonary aur aortic valves khule hote hain. Ek mukammal dharkan mein diastole qareeb 0.4 second, atrial systole qareeb 0.1 second aur ventricular systole qareeb 0.3 second rehti hai. Zindagi bhar mein dil qareeb 2.5 billion baar bina ruke dharakta hai.
Dharkan ki awazein

Jab dono ventricles ek saath sukar kar khoon pulmonary arteries aur aorta mein pump karte hain to tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band hote hain aur lubb ki awaz banti hai. Jab ventricular systole khatm hoti aur dono ventricles dheele hote hain to pulmonary aur aortic semilunar valves band hote hain aur dubb ki awaz banti hai; lubb-dubb stethoscope se suni ja sakti hai. Agar valves poori tarah band na hon, ya tang khulein, to dil ke andar halchal (turbulence) banti hai jo heart murmur ke taur par suni jati hai, jo seeti (hiss) jaisi lagti hai. Zyada tar murmurs sangeen nahin hote; jo hon unhen kharab valves ko masnooi valves ya kisi organ donor ke valves se badal kar theek kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Pehlu-ba-pehlu teen chhote chaar-khane dil: diastole jis mein teer atria mein dakhil hote hain, atrial systole jis mein teer atria se ventricles mein jate hain, aur ventricular systole jis mein teer band AV valves ki kaali pattiyon ke paas se oopar ventricles se nikalte hain. Muddatein unwanon mein hain, aur neeche ek box lubb aur dubb ki awazein aur murmurs samjhata hai.
blocks.caption: Ek dharkan ke teen marhale aur dil ki awazein (Figure 11.3 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Diastole mein, qareeb 0.4 second, tamam khane dheele hain aur atria khuli AV valves se bari veins se bharte hain jab ke semilunar valves band hain. Atrial systole mein, qareeb 0.1 second, atria sukar kar khoon tricuspid aur bicuspid valves se dheele ventricles mein dhakelte hain. Ventricular systole mein, qareeb 0.3 second, ventricles sukarte hain, AV valves band hote hain (lubb) aur khoon khule pulmonary aur aortic valves se nikalta hai; jab ventricles dheele hote hain to woh semilunar valves band hote hain (dubb). Murmur us valve ki halchal ki seeti hai jo poora band nahin hota ya tang khulta hai.

blocks.text: Dharkan ka qaboo (dil ki tehreek aur sukar)

Dil ka pump karna sinoatrial node (SA node) ya pacemaker shuru karta hai, cardiac muscle cells ka ek chhota guchha jo daen atrium ki oopri deewar mein dhansa hai. Dharkan tab shuru hoti hai jab SA node atria ki deewaron ko barqi impulses bhejta hai, jis se dono atria ek saath sukarte hain. Phir impulses atrioventricular node (AV node) tak jate hain, jo bhi cardiac muscle cells ka chhota guchha hai, interatrial septum ke nichle hisse mein. AV node se impulses atrioventricular bundle, ya bundle of His, tak pohnchte hain, jo interventricular septum mein reshon ka jaal hai; yeh baen aur daen shakhon mein batta hai, jo ventricles ki deewaron mein Purkinje fibres par khatm hoti hain, aur in reshon ki tehreek ventricles ko taqreeban ek saath sukarti hai. SA node se AV node tak impulses ki rasai mein qareeb 0.15 second ki takheer hai, jo ventricular systole shuru hone se pehle atrial systole mukammal hone deti hai.

blocks.title: Masnooi pacemaker
blocks.text: Agar barqi impulses ka bahao rukta ho, ya SA node ke impulses kamzor hon, to dharkan ki ba-qaidgi mein takheer ho sakti ya woh ruk sakti hai. Aise mareezon mein masnooi pacemaker, ek battery se chalne wala aala jo surgery se AV node ke qareeb lagaya jata hai, barqi signals bhej kar mamool ki dharkanein shuru karta hai.
Dharkan ki raftar

Ausat balig ka dil minute mein qareeb 70 baar dharakta hai aur har minute poora khoon, qareeb 5 litre, pump karta hai. Mamool ki raftar pacemaker aur AV node banate aur qaim rakhte hain, magar dimagh bhi kuch asar dalta hai: bukhar aur warzish mein dimagh ka control centre pacemaker aur AV node dono ko aasabi signals bhej kar dil ki raftar barhata hai, taake soorat-e-haal se nipta ja sake, aur neend ya aaram mein un ki sargarmi sust karta hai.
Electrocardiogram

Cardiac impulses ke currents se bane barqi potentials ki recording electrocardiogram (ECG) hai. Jab cardiac impulse dil ki satah par guzarta hai to ek nanha barqi current banta hai, jo gird ke tissues mein phailta aur jism ki satah tak jata hai. ECG mein is current ke potentials dil ki mukhalif simton par jild par lage electrodes se nape aur record kiye jate hain, jo ek machine, electrocardiograph, se jure hote hain. ECG dil ke conduction nizam ki kharabiyan pehchanne mein madad deta hai aur cardiac cycle ke khaas waqiat par neeche di gai lehrein dikhata hai.

items: P wave: SA node se shuru hone wali atrial depolarisation ki shuruat, jo atria ko sukarti hai. Be-tarteeb ya ghair-maujood P waves arrhythmia (ba-qaidgi ki kami) batati hain.
PR segment: atrial depolarisation ka mukammal hona, aam taur par 0.12 se 0.20 second. Lamba PR first-degree heart block batata hai.

QRS complex: ventricular depolarisation ki shuruat; is marhale mein atrial repolarisation bhi hoti hai. Kharabiyan bundle branch block, ventricular tachycardia (sukar ki tez raftar) ya ventricles ki doosri kharabiyan bata sakti hain.

ST segment: ventricular depolarisation ka mukammal hona, aam taur par qareeb 0.08 second. Ischaemia (dil ke pathon ko khoon aur oxygen ka kam bahao) mein yeh dab sakta aur myocardial infarction mein uth sakta hai.
T wave: ventricular repolarisation ki shuruat. T wave ki kharabiyan electrolyte ki gar-bar bata sakti hain; hyper-acute T wave acute myocardial infarction ki sab se pehli nishani hai.
QT interval: QRS complex ki shuruat se T wave ke aakhir tak, mamool mein qareeb 0.40 second.

blocks.alt: Baen: dil ka khaaka jis mein daen atrium ke oopar narangi SA node atria par narangi teer bhejta hai jamni AV node tak, septum mein neeche jamni bundle of His do shakhon mein batta hai, aur ventricles ki deewaron mein sabz Purkinje fibres. Daen: gulabi grid par ECG trace jis par P, Q, R, S aur T likhe hain, aur neeche har lehr aur segment par notes.
blocks.caption: Dil ka conducting nizam aur ek dharkan ka ECG (Figures 11.4 aur 11.5 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Daen atrium ki oopri deewar mein SA node chalta hai aur us ka impulse dono atria par phailta hai, jo ek saath sukarte hain; nichle interatrial septum mein AV node par qareeb 0.15 second ki takheer ke baad impulse interventricular septum mein bundle of His se neeche, us ki do shakhon se, ventricles ki deewaron ke Purkinje fibres tak jata hai, aur dono ventricles taqreeban ek saath sukarte hain. ECG par P wave atrial depolarisation hai, PR segment us ka mukammal hona (0.12 se 0.20 second), QRS complex ventricular depolarisation, ST segment us ka mukammal hona (qareeb 0.08 second), T wave ventricular repolarisation, aur QT interval qareeb 0.40 second.

blocks.title: Khoon ka safar
blocks.text: Balig mein har din qareeb 8,000 litre khoon 96,000 km khoon ki naliyon se guzarta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek mareez ka ECG mamool ki P wave magar 0.30 second ka PR segment dikhata hai. Conducting nizam ka kaun sa hissa sust hai, aur dil phir bhi tarteeb se kyun dharakta hai?
blocks.explanation: P wave batati hai ke SA node aur atria kaam kar rahe hain, to takheer AV node par hai, jis ki rasai lambi ho gai hai: first-degree heart block. Chunke AV node atria se ventricles tak wahid rasta hai, impulse phir bhi bundle of His aur Purkinje fibres tak pohnchta hai, to ventricles ab bhi atria ke baad sukarte hain, bas mamool ki 0.15 second ki takheer se der se.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Dil phephron ke beech pericardium mein hai (fibrous bairooni tah; serous parietal aur visceral tahein jin ke beech 50 mL tak mayah); is ki deewar epicardium, myocardium aur endocardium hai.

Chaar khane: patli-deewar atria, moti-deewar ventricles (baen qareeb teen guna mota); tricuspid aur bicuspid (mitral) AV valves ventricular systole mein band hote hain; pulmonary aur aortic semilunar valves diastole mein. Daen taraf: venae cavae se pulmonary trunk. Baen taraf: pulmonary veins se aorta.

Cardiac cycle: diastole 0.4 s, atrial systole 0.1 s, ventricular systole 0.3 s; lubb (AV valves) aur dubb (semilunar valves); murmur kharab valve ki seeti hai. Minute mein qareeb 70 dharkanein, minute mein 5 litre, zindagi mein 2.5 billion.

SA node (pacemaker) se AV node (0.15 s takheer) se bundle of His se Purkinje fibres; dimagh ise tez ya sust karta hai. ECG: P, PR, QRS, ST, T, QT arrhythmia, blocks, ischaemia aur infarction zahir karte hain.
